text:
The function builder’s defaults dictionary already includes keyword-only defaults. Its argument formatting still used `inspect.formatargspec`, which is unavailable on Python 3.11+, so I’ve replaced that dependency with a warning-free formatter.

I also found reverse-subtraction issues and several requested glom spec types missing from this checkout. I’m adding those APIs while preserving existing behavior, including OneToOne’s tested collision-overwrite behavior on assignment.
